name: Sodium
summary: Sodium is the main salt in your blood. Its level mostly reflects the balance of water in your body.

high.meaning: A high sodium usually means the body is short of water.
commonCauses: Not drinking enough, especially in older adults

low.meaning: A low sodium usually means there is too much water relative to salt. Mild drops can cause tiredness; severe drops are dangerous.
commonCauses: Drinking very large amounts of fluid

sources.title: Clinical practice guideline on diagnosis and treatment of hyponatraemia
